rule: An origin is hashed as the SHA-256 of its exact bytes. No cleaning, no normalization.
The hash lives beside the file (origin.sha256), never inside it.
The authoritative check is sha256sum -c, which any machine has.
An edit makes a new hash; for an origin that means an amendment, never a replacement.
Where a document must carry an embedded passport (the older format), the hash covers everything before one exact marker line, in one shared module, tested against sha256sum on the same bytes.
left_open: Branch protection cannot be enforced on a private repo outside a Team or Enterprise account. RULES.md declares the policy in words; a detection workflow for origins/ is not built.
Whether a scan that flags a hash file needs an exemption. None has so far; the smallest exemption (the hash files only, never the origin) is described in ARMARIUM.md section 3.
